newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept fed tax receipts at 8.049 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept fed tax receipts at 8.049 bln reais.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts totaled 8.049 billion reais in September, up from 7.436 billion reais in August, the Internal Revenue Service said.
The ministry said it was a 16.78 percent increase over September 1995, when tax receipts hit 6.892 billion reaism.
The revenue service said September tax receipts, adjusted for inflation, increased 8.10 percent over August.
In nominal terms, tax receipts in the January-September period were 69.006 billion reais, versus 62.131 billion reais in the same period a year ago.

However, once adjusted for inflation, the January-September tax receipts showed a real 0.62 percent drop to 70.854 billion reais from 71.297 billion reais in the same period in 1995, the revenue service said.
